resources.string: Shows a block screen over Instagram Reels so you can get on with your day. Watches only the Instagram app, nothing else.
Reels Blocker works through an accessibility service. Flip it on in Settings and you\'re done.
Toggle greyed out? App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Standing guard — reels get a friendly block screen.
Turning this off pauses blocking for 5 minutes only.
Blocking turns itself back on when the timer runs out.
Debug aid for when an Instagram update breaks detection. Dumps land in:\n%1$s
